The everyday
problem.

Stock information can be spread across records and repeated manual updates. That makes it harder to understand what is available and what needs attention.

The direction of this project is a more useful overview, shaped around the decisions a business needs to make.

What we’re
exploring.

The project is still in development. These are areas of focus, not a finished feature promise.
